sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (U.S.-derived corporate and commercial law blended with traditional customary law over land and title matters)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States of America (1986, as amended 2003) - Title II tax treatment and trade provisions
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER) Plus (signed 2017; in force for RMI 13 December 2020)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended (RMI Associations Law, Parts IV and VII: registered office, registered agent, shareholder and beneficiary owner record requirements); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Act 2012, as amended 2018 (customer due diligence, beneficial ownership identification, record keeping and suspicious transaction reporting); RMI National Risk Assessment (2019) and FATF Asia/Pacific Group mutual evaluation follow-up framework.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport (each UBO and director)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin / issuing passport authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (RMI is a contracting party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention) OR consular legalization where the origin state is not a Convention party

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement, issued within the last 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed financial institution in the UBO's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter for the UBO and/or proposed shareholder entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed financial institution maintaining the account relationship

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Due Formation and Good Standing (if a UBO is a legal entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or equivalent authority of the entity's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the RMI licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of execution

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, officers, shareholders and UBOs at onboarding and on an ongoing basis against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, U.S. OFAC SDN List, UK HMT Consolidated List, and RMI domestic targeted financial sanctions list; full name, alias, date of birth and nationality matching; enhanced due diligence (EDD) applied to all politically exposed persons (FATF R.12) and to ownership chains where any intermediate entity holding 25% or more is itself screened; negative news and adverse media checks required; the registered agent must retain screening evidence with the statutory UBO record for at least 6 years after the relationship ends.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Corporate Registry, administered by International Registries, Inc. (IRI) under delegation from the Office of the Registrar of Corporations, RMI Ministry of Finance; filing channel via the licensed Registered Agent (register-iri.com online platform)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be registered in the English language using Latin (Roman) script only; names in foreign scripts are transliterated phonetically into English letters; the name must be distinguishable from all registered and reserved names and from recognized international bodies; a corporate identifier suffix (Corporation, Corp., Incorporated, Inc., Limited, Ltd., or Company) is mandatory; no Cyrillic, Arabic or CJK characters may appear in the legal name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name reservations under an approved Name Clearance are valid for 30 calendar days from the date of issue; a single 30-day extension may be obtained by written request to the registered agent before expiry. If the name is rejected or difficult to distinguish, the Registered Agent must file a corrected or alternative name clearance request. An administrative appeal must be lodged with the Registrar of Corporations within 21 days of the rejection notice, supported by a written memorandum and proposed alternative name; if the Registrar confirms rejection, the applicant or its Registered Agent may seek judicial review in the RMI High Court within 30 days of the final administrative decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for the Non-Resident Business Corporation: the statutory registered office may be the street address of the licensed RMI registered agent; no physical business premises, staff or local assets are required for a non-resident Micro SaaS entity; however, the registered agent must maintain a physical presence in the RMI and full access to corporate and UBO records.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low risk (approximately <5% annualized for the first three operating years) for an unlicensed, low-risk consumer Micro SaaS business with no local physical footprint; however, the Registrar and the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit retain discretionary inspection and records-access powers under the AML/CFT Act 2012, and any unexplained inconsistency in registered-agent records materially increases the likelihood of examination.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search and availability clearance (Name Clearance)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations (via licensed Registered Agent)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff as published by the RMI Registrar / IRI fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation filing fee (Business Corporation, non-resident, first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the RMI Business Corporations Act 1990 fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and registered office service (first year retainer)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed RMI Registered Agent (IRI-affiliated corporate service provider)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a non-resident standard-risk Business Corporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO register setup, shareholder ledger and corporate records book
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Registered Agent / corporate services provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for AML/CFT-compliant record preparation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT due diligence, UBO identity verification and sanctions/PEP screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark per UBO and screening event

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and apostille legalization bundle (five documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and Competent Apostille Authority in the country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing government and notarial tariff in the origin jurisdiction

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Courier delivery of original executed documents (international)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market courier charge, tracked and insured

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act, Title 27 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code (Sections 27-101 through 27-1210), specifically Sections 27-201 (Incorporation), 27-301 (Registered Office and Agent), and 27-1101 (Board of Directors)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Commerce and Investment, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form BCA-01) filed with the Registrar of Corporations
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is prescribed; the corporation may commence operations upon issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation; no escrow account is required for non-resident business corporations
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the corporation accept the subscription for shares in the numbers and for the consideration set forth in the Subscription Agreement, and that the Secretary be directed to issue share certificates accordingly. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office at the address filed with the Registrar of Corporations shall be and hereby is adopted as the statutory principal office of the corporation. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the individuals named in the organizational consent are hereby appointed as the initial officers, each with the customary powers and duties of their respective offices, to serve until replaced by the Board. RESOLVED, that the Board approves the opening of corporate bank and payment-rail accounts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Filing and Corporate Book Completion
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations and Business Licensing Office, Ministry of Commerce and Investment
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receipt of the Certificate of Incorporation, file any necessary post-incorporation notices (such as beneficial ownership or officer changes) and compile the statutory corporate records: Articles, Bylaws, board and shareholder minutes, share ledger, and registered agent consent. No operational license is required for the Micro-SaaS business itself; ensure payment-rail provider underwriting documents are available if requested.
required_dossiers: Payment-rail compliance questionnaire (if required by Paddle or Lemon Squeezy)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar identifies a filing discrepancy, file the applicable amendment or statement of correction within 5 business days of the notice; if the payment provider flags documentation, supply certified corporate documents and any requested UBO declarations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — no industrial physical establishment is required for the operation of a lightweight cloud software subscription business. If physical premises were later used, the Ministry of Commerce and Investment would administer general business licenses.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required for non-physical SaaS operations under ISIC 6201; no manufacturing or fixed-premises operating permit applicable

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority (EPA), Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — the business does not involve wastewater discharge, VOC emissions, hazardous waste, or any pollutant-generating activity; no EIA registration is required
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No applicable thresholds; the business is not subject to RMI wastewater, VOC, or solid waste discharge permit standards. If future physical operations are introduced, the entity must apply for an Environmental Protection Act Permit or specific registration under EPA review.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable — no brick-and-mortar workplace, plant, or storage facility exists. Fire safety certification and structural load inspections are not triggered. Work-from-home or remote contract operations remain outside civil defense and occupational clearance requirements. If a dedicated office is later opened, the entity would need a certificate of occupancy and fire safety inspection from the local Majuro authorities.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Customs Division, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro, MH); corporate registry administered by the Registrar of Corporations. Filing is paper-based or via licensed registered agents; there is no centralized electronic tax portal for online TIN issuance.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident Business Corporation (MH_BC) is not required to obtain an RMI TIN unless it derives income from sources within the Marshall Islands. Where RMI-source activity exists, the entity must: (i) complete RCD TIN Application Form with certified charter and registered-agent authorization; (ii) obtain a Foreign Investment Business License (FIBL) if engaging in foreign investment business; (iii) file the application with the Revenue and Customs Division. With no RMI-source activity, no TIN is required; the entity remains compliant through annual corporate report filings with the Registrar of Corporations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: RMI law provides no check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch entity classification election. Taxation follows statutory source rules: non-resident corporations are taxed only on RMI-source gross revenue at the standard gross-receipts rate, while foreign-source income is exempt. A non-resident Business Corporation may elect to remain dormant (no RMI-source activity, no tax filing obligation) or, if FIBL-licensed, elect an approved activity scope; no transparent/opaque entity election exists.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None — no VAT/GST or general sales/use tax; indirect levies are limited to customs and excise duties on physical imports under the Customs and Excise Act.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — the Marshall Islands levies no VAT/GST, so no economic turnover threshold triggers registration. Separate customs registration is required only for physical importers of dutiable goods, with no minimum threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No statutory e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API reporting, or digital stamping regime exists. Commercial invoicing follows contract norms; customs clearance for tangible goods uses RMI Customs Entry paperwork and manual duty assessment.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable — with no VAT/GST system, there is no export zero-rating mechanism or input VAT refund. Cross-border SaaS subscription revenue earned by the non-resident Business Corporation is foreign-source and outside RMI gross-receipts tax, provided no RMI-source marketing, local bank account, or domestic business activities are conducted.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (RMI Customs Export Entry; required only for physical goods)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill (required only for physical goods)
Inward Remittance Certificate (bank evidence of foreign payment; best practice for substantiating foreign-source SaaS revenue)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating fraud is not a statutory category in the absence of VAT. However, mischaracterization of RMI-source revenue as foreign-source to evade the gross-receipts tax is subject to Revenue and Customs Division audit, retrospective reassessments, 50% fraud penalty plus interest, criminal fines up to USD 10,000, and imprisonment up to 5 years. False customs declarations for physical exports attract seizure and penalties up to treble the duty evaded.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Republic of the Marshall Islands has no central bank and no dedicated foreign-exchange administration. RMI banking and financial services supervision is conducted by the Financial Institutions Commission (FIC) under the Banking Act 1991. The United States Federal Reserve serves as the de facto monetary authority because the U.S. dollar is the sole circulating legal tender.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The U.S. dollar is the official currency of the Marshall Islands; therefore capital- and current-account transactions are fully convertible. There are no exchange controls, no discriminatory dual exchange-rate mechanisms, and no RMI government approval requirement for profit repatriation or dividend remittance. The only practical hurdles are bank-level compliance, source-of-funds verification, and the absence of an RMI central bank to provide liquidity backstop or payment settlement services.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory requirement in the Republic of the Marshall Islands for exporters to surrender export proceeds to the government or to a central bank, and no mandatory minimum conversion ratio exists. Exporters and SaaS operators may freely retain, borrow, or remit U.S.-dollar export receipts from authorized banking channels. The RMI imposes no foreign-exchange repatriation timeline on cross-border settlement proceeds.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational USD Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium. The RMI does not license fintech e-money institutions or digital banks; no locally authorized EMI regime exists. Offshore digital EMIs such as Wise, Airwallex, or Mercury cannot act as a primary RMI bank account and are not eligible for a Financial Institutions Commission license. They may be used only as ancillary payment-settlement or payout-consolidation utilities if the underlying settlement flows ultimately clear into a RMI-banked or U.S.-correspondent USD account. Legal acceptance by onboarding banks is very low because EMIs often lack full conduit-bank transparency and may present an elevated OFAC/AML risk.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence in the RMI is strongly required for first-time corporate account opening. RMI-licensed banks generally mandate that at least one director, the compliance signatory, or the registered agent attend a branch interview in Majuro with an original notarized corporate resolution and identification. Pure remote or fully digital onboarding is not generally available to non-resident Business Corporations. A remote video interview may supplement, but does not entirely replace, the physical verification requirement when the ultimate beneficial owner is domiciled outside the RMI.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident tax-exempt status and lack of tangible physical office in the RMI
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Good Standing from the RMI Registrar, registered agent services agreement, board resolution designating the operational management location, audited or management financial statements, detailed business plan for the Consumer Micro-SaaS, and a beneficial-ownership declaration identifying all ultimate natural persons.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Nominee shareholders, registered-agent-director structures, and opaque ownership
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete ultimate-beneficial-owner schedule, trust deed or escrow agreement if the shareholder is a trust/vehicle, sworn source-of-wealth statement for each beneficial owner, signed indemnity and consent to bank AML enquiries, and independent professional reference letters issued by a licensed lawyer or accountant.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Receipts originating from third-party software marketplaces and payment processors
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed merchant of record agreements with Paddle and Lemon Squeezy, processor payout settlement statements, customer chargeback/refund analytics, PCI-DSS attestation provided by the processor, sample end-user license agreements, and IP-country transaction logs demonstrating legitimate recurring SaaS subscriptions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Shareholder capital injection routed from a non-deposit-taking financial institution or crypto gateway
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-funds package consisting of investor bank statements, wire initiation authorization, board subscription resolution, capital call documentation, shareholder loan agreement, and a bourse- or exchange-ledger report if any crypto-to-fiat conversion occurred prior to funding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outbound cross-border payments to software suppliers, cloud providers, and overseas contractors
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Vendor contracts and invoicing, cloud infrastructure subscription schedules, licensing agreements, service-level agreements, recipient due-diligence forms, sanctions/PEP screening results, and a consolidated treasury payment register approved by the managing director.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The RMI has no exchange-control permit requirement. Inbound equity or shareholder loan funds are cleared as a U.S.-dollar wire through the foreign banking system into the RMI operating or capital escrow account. The compliant routing protocol is a SWIFT MT103 with the beneficiary bank's RMI account and correspondent details, the originator's full legal name, and a purpose code indicating 'private equity injection' or 'subscription consideration'. The field-70 remittance information should reference the corporate subscription resolution and the entity identifier 'MH_BC'. The bank must hold a board resolution, the signed subscription agreement, and source-of-funds documentation before crediting the capital account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Routine SaaS trade settlements are conducted via SWIFT MT103 transfers from the MH_BC treasury account to licensed software vendors, cloud infrastructure providers, and overseas commission agents. Commercial letters of credit are acceptable where physical hardware, colocation equipment, or resale services create documentary trade risk, but they are not the primary rail for a pure micro-SaaS model. For recurring payouts, domestic U.S.-dollar clearing through Fedwire or ACH can be used if the operating account maintains a U.S. correspondent or if the RMI bank offers same-day USD clearing. Payment-processor proceeds from Paddle and Lemon Squeezy are swept in USD into the treasury account on net settlement cycles, then applied to the liquidity waterfall.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: U.S.-dollar/Euro cross-currency interest rate swaps for term debt and infrastructure obligations
Zero-cost U.S.-dollar/Euro collars where a bank-approved corporate hedging policy exists
Non-deliverable forwards are legally permissible in RMI but are not recommended due to limited local counterparty interest and the full convertibility of the U.S. dollar

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report of Domestic Business Corporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands Maritime and Corporate Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than 30 days after the anniversary date of incorporation, annually thereafter
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of USD 100; failure to file and pay for two consecutive annual cycles subjects the corporation to administrative dissolution and strike-off by the Registrar.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office and Registered Agent Address Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed together with the annual report; within 30 days after any change of registered office or registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a licensed registered agent and a physical registered office in the Marshall Islands is a ground for administrative dissolution; continued default triggers strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Authorized and Issued Share Capital Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted as part of the annual report on the annual anniversary cycle
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Materially false or late share capital declarations attract late-filing penalties and may be treated as grounds for administrative dissolution and strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act. A non-resident micro-SaaS business corporation is not required to appoint an independent auditor or file financial statements with the Registrar.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory domestic GAAP is prescribed for Marshall Islands business corporations; IFRS is the commonly adopted framework for internal financial statements, with US GAAP also acceptable.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The annual report confirms current director details and issued share capital; all share transfers during the year must be recorded in the Register of Members before the report is certified. Beneficial ownership details are not filed with the Registrar but are maintained internally through the shareholder register and corporate resolutions.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 800–1,500 per year for standard Marshall Islands registered agent and registered office services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 2,000–8,000 per year for a voluntarily appointed independent audit of a micro-SaaS business corporation

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Non-resident domestic corporations are entirely outside the Marshall Islands income tax base. Zero corporate income tax on worldwide income, zero branch profits tax, zero capital gains tax, zero withholding tax on distributions, and no payroll or social security tax for non-resident employees. The only fixed annual cost is the Marshall Islands corporate license / annual franchise fee payable to the Registrar of Corporations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Corporate Income Tax Return. The Marshall Islands Income Tax Act does not require exempt non-resident domestic corporations to file an annual income tax Form. The only periodic filing obligation is the Annual Corporate Renewal / Annual Report filed with the Registrar of Corporations through the entity's licensed registered agent or the Registrar's electronic corporate registry portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Report and annual franchise fee are due on or before September 30 of each calendar year for corporations using a December 31 fiscal year. For other fiscal year ends, the statutory deadline is on or before the anniversary of the date of incorporation falling in the reporting year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact registered corporate name and registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the precise name on the Certificate of Incorporation; no expansion or translation should be used for a non-resident BC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in the Republic of the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the licensed registered agent's physical RMI address; the corporation need not maintain local premises or employees.
The registered agent must be an RMI-licensed resident agent. The non-resident BC may not self-appoint a foreign entity as agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors and officers details, including full legal name and residential address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List non-resident directors and officers; provide passport, national identity, or residency evidence sufficient for the registered agent's AML onboarding file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital, share classes, and total issued shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact share schedule from the Articles of Incorporation; the annual license fee may be computed on authorized share count.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of non-resident status and no RMI-source income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Certify that the corporation is a non-resident domestic corporation, derives no income from Marshall Islands sources, and is therefore exempt from income tax. Retain a copy of the declaration for 10 years.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Beneficial ownership declaration of all individuals holding 10% or more of issued shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide full beneficial ownership particulars, including physical address and citizenship, to comply with RMI anti-money laundering and transparency obligations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Because no income tax return is imposed, there is no CIT late-filing daily surcharge. Failure to pay the annual franchise fee by the statutory deadline triggers an escalating late administrative penalty, the entity may be struck off or administratively dissolved after continued default, and reinstatement requires payment of outstanding government fees and a reinstatement fee. Where foreign tax compliance is separately relevant, foreign jurisdictions may apply local penalties for absence of transfer pricing documentation.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No bilateral income tax treaty network is available to the Marshall Islands. There is no dividend withholding tax to relieve, so no DTA relief application or Tax Residency Certificate procedure is required. A non-resident BC should provide a Board Resolution and the Registrar-issued Certificate of Good Standing as evidentiary documents of its corporate existence when a foreign paying agent requests a reduced rate on flow-through royalties or interest from another jurisdiction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding tax on cross-border royalties and interest paid by a Marshall Islands non-resident business corporation. Treaty relief is not applicable because the Marshall Islands does not maintain comprehensive double-taxation agreements that reduce statutory rates.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable. Marshall Islands tax law does not prescribe a Local File or Master File threshold and does not impose transfer-pricing documentation obligations on exempt non-resident domestic corporations. For OECD-aligned foreign reporting, the entity should benchmark intercompany arrangements using the prevailing foreign parent-country threshold if the ultimate parent is subject to BEPS Action 13 rules.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Marshall Islands has not enacted Economic Substance Regulations in the manner of the UAE, Mauritius, or BVI. There is no statutory requirement for local physical office, local employees, or local core income-generating activities to maintain a non-resident BC's tax-exempt status. However, international information-exchange pressure imposes a substance expectation: the entity must demonstrate genuine non-resident status through registered agent records, minutes of board meetings, and beneficial ownership transparency. If a foreign tax authority recharacterizes the entity as a shell, the corporation may lose foreign tax credits or become subject to Controlled Foreign Company attribution abroad.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Misrepresentation of Non-Resident Status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly filing a false Annual Renewal declaration claiming zero RMI-source income, or conducting Marshall Islands-local commercial operations while claiming non-resident exempt status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The exemption is void ab initio; the corporation becomes taxable on its RMI-source income under the Income Tax Act and may be subject to fines, interest charges, and criminal prosecution. Regulatory authorities may also strike off the corporation for non-compliance with corporate registry conditions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false declarations are jointly and severally liable for resulting tax, penalties, and restitution. Criminal exposure includes fines, asset seizure, travel restrictions, and imprisonment under RMI criminal and revenue statutes.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance Used as a Tax Avoidance Vehicle
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the non-resident BC as a zero-tax booking shell for intercompany software royalties or management fees, without any commercial rationale, board oversight, or realistic arm's-length substance, so that value creation is artificially diverted away from the real operating jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Not separately penalized under Marshall Islands law, but the entity will be reassessed by foreign revenue authorities; aggressive jurisdictions may deny withholding tax treaty benefits, impose transfer-pricing adjustments, add penalties up to 100% of the under-reported tax, and issue permanent establishment notices.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Foreign tax authorities and insolvency courts may pierce the corporate veil; directors may face civil restitution, dismissal of travel rights through court orders, freezing injunctions, and imprisonment for conspiracy to defraud revenue authorities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering and Beneficial Ownership Non-Disclosure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Concealing the true shareholder or beneficial owner behind nominee shareholders, issuing bearer shares, or omitting required beneficial ownership details when the micro-SaaS business accepts payment-rail subscriptions and distributes profits through opaque layers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI anti-money laundering legislation empowers the Financial Intelligence Unit to impose monetary administrative penalties for each breach, to freeze assets, and to refer criminal prosecutions for money laundering. A struck-off listing follows failure to cure disclosure defaults.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers of the BC are personally liable for AML breaches; they may be fined, disqualified as directors, prohibited from leaving the Marshall Islands, and imprisoned for wilful money laundering facilitation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlawful Dividend Distribution and Asset Stripping
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Repatriating profits as dividends while the corporation is technically insolvent, without a board-approved solvency determination, or while taxes, debts, or creditor obligations remain unpaid.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act, illegal dividends are void or voidable and must be restored to the corporation. The Registrar may dissolve the corporation for distributive abuse, and creditor proceedings may recover the transferred assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who vote for or consent to an unlawful distribution are personally liable for the full amount of the distribution, plus interest and costs; egregious cases trigger civil restitution, travel bans during enforcement proceedings, and criminal liability for fraudulent transfer.
